accountable_decision_owner: Cole Lyons, USHSO Public Alpha methodology owner
active_family_basis: No common safety-net numerator, denominator, setting, system boundary, or period is receipted; AHRQ binary burden flags and hospital-scoped CMS DPP cannot be substituted, aggregated, imputed, or converted into fabricated zeroes.
active_family_definition: Percent of patients or encounters meeting one preapproved safety-net definition, using a common numerator, denominator, setting, organizational boundary, and aligned period across all six product systems.
comparison_period_rule: No common period or lag window is approved; AHRQ 2023 binary context and CMS FY 2024 DPP definition evidence cannot be substituted for aligned product-system patient-mix observations.
comparison_purpose: Determine whether safety_net_patient_mix_pct can be appended to the common nine-input Scale v1 packet without weakening the frozen roster, period, definition, boundary, or safety-net-denominator gates.
